title: Trace correction parsing to precedence epoch

identity.dirty: not applicable; read-only archive plus /work/out outputs

findings.invariant: RFC 0002 §6.5 says correct bumps claims_epoch; subsequent packet reads must observe staleness
findings.evidence: After one ordinary tell --claim, stored getClaimsEpoch is 1 and computed serving claimsEpoch is 2 (1 owner_correction + 1 R5 supersession). serveCorrect never calls bumpClaimsEpoch; packets still move because they use the computed number. App host visibility_epoch uses sourcePolicyEpoch:getClaimsEpoch.
findings.required_of_downstream: P022 and P084 must treat stored vault_epoch and packet claims_epoch as distinct numbers. Do not collapse them. Do not assume MCP correct() bumps vault_epoch.
findings.not_fixed_here: No authority redesign. P003 retains shared evidence design.

findings.invariant: Idempotent owner evidence identity is sha256(statement || 0 || target_json)
findings.evidence: CLI correct() targetJson omits empty keys and includes page_id; event kind is note; request_digest equals source_record_id. serveCorrect serializes {claim_id, claim_key, subject} with nulls, omits page_id, uses kind correction, and hashes [statement, target, object] as request_digest. objectFromStatement is CLI-only; MCP uses args.object or negative polarity.
findings.required_of_downstream: Do not assume one source_record_id function. Map the CLI tell path for parse.ts/epoch.ts/evidence.ts; treat MCP as a sibling.
